description_en: Creates a private endpoint for an ES Serverless application. You can create a maximum of 50 private endpoints per region. Only VPC-type endpoints are currently supported, which establish a private connection between your Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) and the ES Serverless service. This operation automatically creates the `AliyunServiceRoleForESServerless` service-linked role if it does not exist
description_zh: 调用CreateEndpoint接口，创建ES Serverless应用的私网终端节点，目前限制用户每个区域最多创建50个。目前仅支持创建VPC类型的端点，用来打通用户VPC网络和ES Serverless服务的网络。调用该接口会默认帮助用户创建AliyunServiceRoleForESServerless角色
kebab_example: aliyun es-serverless create-endpoint --endpoint-zones vswitchId=vsw-uf6qmfkqdcw00000 zoneId=cn-hangzhou-h --vpc-id vpc-uf664nyle5khp5000 --name testendpoint --type VPC --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateEndpoint

parameters.description_en: The zone configuration for the endpoint.

element_fields.description_en:
The ID of the zone. The following regions and zones are supported:

- China (Hangzhou): cn-hangzhou-h, cn-hangzhou-g, cn-hangzhou-i

- China (Beijing): cn-beijing-g, cn-beijing-h, cn-beijing-i

- China (Shenzhen): cn-shenzhen-d, cn-shenzhen-e, cn-shenzhen-f

- China (Shanghai): cn-shanghai-b, cn-shanghai-f, cn-shanghai-g
element_fields.description_zh:
